start.text: (Ravi, head bandaged, staring at the ceiling.) Oh. Hi. Do I - sorry. Do I know you?

loop1_supported.text: (Ravi turns his head, slowly.) You. You came at one in the morning. Nobody comes at one in the morning.

loop1_left.text: (Ravi looks at you as if he's trying to place you, and doesn't.) Hi.

loop1b.text: Where's my bike? They'll dock the stipend for the bike. The stipend's still processing. Did I say that?

loop1_end.text: (He closes his eyes.) Appa called. That night. I - (He's asleep.)

loop2.text: Akka's wedding is in Shravana. Three lakh, the loan. (He laughs, then stops - it hurts.) Did I say that already? The samples were mine. Nights. Alone.

loop2_end.text: You change gloves first. Everyone knows you change gloves first. (He's asleep again before you can answer.)

loop3.text: (Awake. Clear, for a moment.) Appa called. That night. In the corridor.

loop3b.text: I answered. (He looks at you.) You're supposed to change gloves first. I answered.

loop3c.text: (He stops. He doesn't say anything else.)

after.text: (Ravi's asleep, or pretending. The green lanyard is on his locker, folded small.)
